notes: Real-time Cross-Tab Sync: All settings, layouts, and widgets now sync instantly across all open tabs without refreshing.
Bookmarks Sync: Adding, editing, or rearranging favorites and folders reflects instantly in every tab.
Widgets in Sync: Notes, Tasks, Counters, Progresses, Mood Tracker, Pet House, and Calendar now stay perfectly synchronized everywhere.
Custom Wallpapers Sync: Uploaded wallpapers and background choices update immediately across tabs.
Enhanced Reliability: Optimized background timer alarms and restored instant window focus when clicking notifications.
Smoother Performance: Faster startup, lower memory footprint, and seamless transitions across settings menus.
Smarter Search: Prevented search suggestions from unexpectedly opening when switching back to Aure from other tabs.
Unified Date Formats: Standardized date and time formatting across all widgets for a consistent experience.
